title: Lithium - How long will the bull market last?
gist: The captured text is only a member-only video page stub from Giga Africa 2026 (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence) with Adam Webb's lithium bull-market session title and a list of sibling session titles; no substantive analysis or data on lithium is present.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's Head of Battery Raw Materials, Adam Webb, presented a session at Giga Africa 2026 on 2 October 2026 framed around how long the lithium bull market will last, implying Benchmark views lithium as currently in a bull market.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb , Head of Battery Raw Materials , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Treat as a pointer to a member-only video; the text gives no price view, duration or drivers.

insights.claim: Giga Africa 2026 programming included a panel on global lithium supply chains and Africa's place in them, covering Africa's growing lithium resources, project pipeline and rising role in battery supply chains, including investment opportunities across the value chain.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb , Head of Battery Raw Materials , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Africa is being positioned by Benchmark as a growing lithium supply and investment destination; watch African lithium project news.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Powering the Battery Boom

insights.claim: The same Giga Africa 2026 agenda featured sessions on copper market supply and demand, graphite and anodes outside China, Africa's battery storage pipeline, and OEM and EV market perspectives in Africa, showing battery-metal and storage themes bundled around African demand and non-China supply.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb , Head of Battery Raw Materials , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Non-China graphite and anode build-out and African storage demand are live conference topics worth tracking.
